reason: Small, targeted change that only reorders when the IsTerminating flag is set relative to the ServiceScopeOnly check and event firing, reducing a race that caused InvalidOperationException on before-dispose callbacks, with minimal surface area and low likelihood of regressing existing shell scope lifecycle behavior.
